scope: Supplementary retrospective replay, not unseen holdout evaluation or recreation of historical tables.
selection: Final 2160 rows, divided into three consecutive 720-row windows; fixed before policy inference.
preprocessing: Recompute indicators over the complete frozen OHLCV prefix using the saved HMM; reset environment context and eight-frame stack at each window. No fitting.
baseline: Cash at zero return; Buy-and-Hold enters next open and exits final close with identical fees/slippage, without the PPO holding-duration rule.
inference: CPU, one thread, seed 42, eval mode, deterministic masked argmax, frozen observation normalizer.
limitations: Checkpoint and HMM training exposure to these dates is not established.
Single checkpoint, one asset, short windows; no seed uncertainty or generalisation claim.
